title: Keep every feature behind the prediction boundary
description: Choose a prediction scenario, split policy, transform fit scope, join contract, and time window. The lab exposes which decisions make offline evidence invalid.

scenarios.label: Customer churn
scenarios.detail: Predict whether a customer will churn in the next 30 days from account history.

scenarios.label: Payment fraud
scenarios.detail: Score a payment at authorization time using only evidence available before the decision.

scenarios.label: Demand forecast
scenarios.detail: Predict future item demand from historical observations and calendar facts.

splitPolicies.label: Random rows
splitPolicies.detail: Rows are shuffled independently; entities and future observations can cross the evaluation boundary.

splitPolicies.label: Hold out entities
splitPolicies.detail: All rows for an entity stay in one split, testing generalization to unseen entities.

splitPolicies.label: Forward time
splitPolicies.detail: Training precedes validation and test periods, preserving the direction of deployment time.

fitScopes.label: Fit on all rows
fitScopes.detail: Imputation, vocabularies, scaling, selection, or encodings can learn from validation and test data.

fitScopes.label: Fit on training only
fitScopes.detail: Learn state from the training fold and apply the frozen state to validation, test, and serving.

joinContracts.label: Unchecked merge
joinContracts.detail: Duplicate dimension keys or missing matches can silently multiply or drop examples.

joinContracts.label: Validated many-to-one
joinContracts.detail: Each fact may match at most one dimension record; row counts and unmatched keys are asserted.

windows.label: Centered window
windows.detail: The feature includes observations after the row timestamp and leaks future evidence.

windows.label: Includes current outcome
windows.detail: The aggregation can include the event or label being predicted.

windows.label: Closed-left past window
windows.detail: The window ends before the prediction event and uses sorted entity event time.
